title: Singapore Dollar-specific Factors Contributing to Persistent Weakness against Malaysian Ringgit
what_it_is: Singapore Dollar-specific Factors Contributing to Persistent Weakness against Malaysian Ringgit

sections.label: Singapore dollar weakness against ringgit
sections.summary: The passage states MAS manages the Singapore dollar against a trade-weighted basket, not bilateral rates, and will monitor developments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (a) what Singapore dollar-specific factors have contributed to its persistent weakness against the Malaysian ringgit; (b) what implications a sustained slide below the exchange rate of 3 Malaysian ringgit/Singapore dollar may have on Singapore’s labour market; and (c) whether MAS will consider strengthening policy settings or adjusting the exchange rate band to ensure stability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: However, it is important to emphasise that the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) manages the Singapore dollar against a trade-weighted basket of currencies of its major trading partners and not against any bilateral exchange rate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Singapore dollar trade-weighted exchange rate has been on a gradual appreciating path since October 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Non-resident labour flows into Singapore principally reflect the economy’s overall growth and employment prospects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MAS will continue to closely monitor economic and financial developments and is in an appropriate position to adjust its monetary policy stance to ensure medium-term price stability.

sections.label: RTS Link Task Force support
sections.summary: The passage states the RTS Link Task Force met to look at ways to enhance local business competitiveness and will announce measures in due course.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, earlier this morning I met with the RTS Link Task Force, of which I am chairing, to look at ways in which to enhance our local business, their competitiveness, their ability to place-make.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In the MTI Committee of Supply, we have also announced many enhancements to the grants and support for heartland businesses, looking forward to both the challenges as well as opportunities of the RTS Link when it is operational at the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, as chairman of the RTS Link Task Force, we are looking at this very carefully.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We have met with Government officials, including Enterprise Singapore, the Housing and Development Board, and the National Environment Agency this morning.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And we will announce these measures in due course.
